data.title: The Effect of Minimum Wages on Low-Wage Jobs
data.abstract: We estimate the effect of minimum wages on low-wage jobs using 138 prominent state-level minimum wage changes between 1979 and 2016 in the United States using a difference-in-differences approach. We first estimate the effect of the minimum wage increase on employment changes by wage bins throughout the wage distribution. We then focus on the bunching of jobs at the minimum wage. We find that the overall number of low-wage jobs remained essentially unchanged over the five years following the increase.

data.title: Machine Learning Estimates of Minimum Wage Employment Effects
data.abstract: We use gradient boosted trees to predict which workers are affected by minimum wage increases and estimate employment effects for the predicted group. The estimated employment effects are small and statistically insignificant.

data.title: Efectos del salario mínimo sobre el empleo formal en México
data.abstract: Este artículo analiza los efectos del salario mínimo sobre el empleo formal en México entre 2010 y 2019. Los resultados muestran que los aumentos del salario mínimo no redujeron el empleo de manera significativa.
